orgName: Hexagon World Series (linked FIP team circuit)

source.name: FIP - 54 and International Padel Federation unite to create the Hexagon World Series
source.note: 54 invests in Hexagon Cup as it becomes the Hexagon World Series; 'Premier Padel is also a shareholder and major strategic partner in the new series'.

note: Indirect link to the tour: 54 (PIF-owned) invests in and commercialises the Hexagon World Series, a separate team competition on the FIP calendar, not a Premier Padel tour sponsor. SportBusiness (17 Dec 2025, via Wayback) named 54 'lead investor'; FIP's own release describes the investment without that phrase.
